feedback: Written before this candidate races, so it states no outcome for it. The held geometry is iteration 8 and 9 (wheel_track 0.09 m, five 12 mm sensors at y = 0.04 m, 0.6 kg). Evidence: iteration 6 (kp 3.5, kd 0.3) scored 153 with oval steering_oscillation 0.2505. Iteration 7 (kp 3.5, kd 0.5) scored 213.28 with oscillation 0.291. Iterations 8 and 9 (kp 3.2, kd 0.5) scored 215.38 with oscillation 0.292. Lowering kp from 3.5 to 3.2 left oscillation unchanged, so yaw gain (kp/wheel_track) is not the oscillation driver at this width. Kd is. Iteration 5 showed oscillation rising at 0.10 m with kp 4.0 and kd 0.3, so narrowing the track also adds some oscillation, but that was the case before kd was raised. S-bend max_error has been flat at 0.061 to 0.064 m across track widths 0.10 to 0.09 m (iterations 5 to 9), so track width alone is unlikely to reach the 0.06 m floor. Sensing changes in iterations 1 to 3 all lowered the score. Next race: if the score stays near 215 with oval oscillation below 0.25, keep the geometry and the kd direction. If oscillation stays above 0.25 at kd 0.4 with the score near 215, the sensor array should not change, and the remaining lever is a controller damping change. If the score falls below 213, kd 0.5 was needed for the score, so keep it and read any oscillation fix as a controller issue, not geometry.
requested_changes: If the score is at or above 213 and s-bend max_error is still above 0.06 m with oval steering_oscillation below 0.25: propose wheel_track 0.08 m, with kp chosen to hold kp/wheel_track near 37.5 (about 3.0). Cite iteration 5 (s-bend max_error 0.0703 to 0.0626 m) and iterations 6 to 9 (flat at 0.061 to 0.064 m) as the reason to test one more narrowing.

If oval steering_oscillation stays above 0.25 at kd 0.4 with the score at or above 213: keep wheel_track 0.09 m and the five-sensor layout. Do not treat kp as the oscillation fix, since kp 3.5 to 3.2 changed oscillation by only 0.001 (iterations 7 and 9).

If the score falls below 213 with the geometry held: keep wheel_track 0.09 m and do not change the sensor array. Cite iterations 1 to 3, where sensor span, footprint and look-ahead changes all lowered the score.
